method: Separate authenticated profiles: real Obsidian native host and a genuine zero-vault account. Controlled management API responses; actual login/editor/permission checks precede presentation fixtures.
execution: Five isolated invocations of check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --management-parity; package script runs these cases sequentially.

checks.existingManagementFlows: passed; desktop and three mobile viewports, 100 closure cycles each
checks.mobileFooters: full width, action first, Cancel last
checks.fieldAndHeadingMetrics: within 2 CSS px; fonts, colors and padding equal
checks.notices: above Settings and dismissed by click
checks.auxiliaryButtons: explicit type; no accidental form submit
checks.animationPosition: unit regression and real mobile comparison

limits: Mobile is Chromium viewport emulation, not physical Android or its keyboard/share sheet.
Same base theme is selected; community themes are not certified.
OIDC UI failures are simulated, not a production provider flow.
Copied feedback geometry is simulated without changing the system clipboard.
GitHub workflow is configured, not remotely executed.
The ordinary suite skips the ENOSPC case that requires the separate container fault harness.
